mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in a month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production, a further drop in the industrial production index below 110 (relative to 2017=100) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines in the same month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer confidence regimes, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 3-month moving average in high consumer confidence regimes, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
